scope: Two freely licensed photographic references. Modern original downloaded unchanged locally; historical original retained in prior image project. Photographs were not projected as model textures.

references.title: Roof of the Arc de Triomphe, Paris 12 June 2014.jpg
references.creator: Connie Ma
references.source: Own work; file page links to Flickr source and marks the transfer as reviewed by FlickreviewR.
references.visualInspection: Warm-gray rectangular stone slabs, narrow joints, shallow level changes, a low perimeter stone edge with modern metal railing, and a small simple raised stone roof structure. Its precise entry shape and placement are not established by this one photograph.
references.roofUse: Good material and paving-module reference; clear restrained stair/exit pavilion and terrace edge. Do not copy modern railings or visitor/access equipment into the historic roof model.

references.title: Aerial view of the Arc de Triomphe, Paris, France, ca. 1900.jpg
references.creator: Unknown author

license.name: Public domain (PD-old; Public Domain Mark on Commons)

references.visualInspection: Original file inspected. High oblique aerial view shows the whole roof as a simple pale rectangular terrace with a continuous perimeter edge/parapet and a very small raised block around the central roof area. Fine paving and exact stair-housing geometry are not resolved clearly in this old, soft image.
references.roofUse: Strong overall footprint and roof-edge/top-oblique reference; use the 2014 terrace photo for paving and pavilion detail. It is not a measured orthographic plan.

supportedRoofLayout: A broad, flat rectangular terrace over the arch body.
Pale warm-gray stone slab paving in large rectangular panels with narrow joints.
A restrained low perimeter edge; the contemporary safety railing is not evidence for historic railing geometry.
A small low roof structure is suggested by the historical aerial. The model uses a deliberately simplified low access block, not a surveyed reconstruction.
No evidence in these sources for added chimneys, decorative rooftop ornaments, or multiple large housings.
synthesis.measurementCaveat: Photos support visual arrangement only; neither source is an orthographic survey or a basis for exact dimensions.

rootReviewNote: Removed helper claim of an arched stair opening: not independently established in root visual review. Model doorway is a simplified rectangular detail.
